info.title: MigrateImages
info.description: Use this API to migrate multiple images from an external site to Lazada site. Allowed image formats are JPG and PNG. The maximum size of an image file is 1MB. A single call can migrate 8 images at most.

post.description: Use this API to migrate multiple images from an external site to Lazada site. Allowed image formats are JPG and PNG. The maximum size of an image file is 1MB. A single call can migrate 8 images at most.

batch_id.description: The returned request ID is used by the GetResponse API to get the migrated image information.

requestCodes.code:
client = LazopApiClient::Client.new(url, appkey, appSecret)
request = LazopApiClient::Request.new('/images/migrate')
request.add_api_parameter("payload", "<?xml version=\"1.0\" encoding=\"UTF-8\" ?> <Request>     <Images>         <Url>http://pic4.nipic.com/20091217/3885730_124701000519_2.jpg</Url>         <Url>http://img.taopic.com/uploads/allimg/120727/201995-120HG1030762.jpg</Url>     </Images> </Request>")
response = client.execute(request, accessToken)
puts response.success?
puts response.body

client = lazop.LazopClient(url, appkey ,appSecret)
request = lazop.LazopRequest('/images/migrate')
request.add_api_param('payload', '<?xml version=\"1.0\" encoding=\"UTF-8\" ?> <Request>     <Images>         <Url>http://pic4.nipic.com/20091217/3885730_124701000519_2.jpg</Url>         <Url>http://img.taopic.com/uploads/allimg/120727/201995-120HG1030762.jpg</Url>     </Images> </Request>')
response = client.execute(request, access_token)
print(response.type)
print(response.body)
